plugin.name: Speech Recognition
plugin.description: Real-time ASR plugin bridging fast-asr WebSocket server to VSM variables

required.name: recording_dir
required.description: Directory recordings are saved into on the fast-asr server, relative to the VSM project directory (an absolute path is also accepted). Sent to the server via POST /set_recording_dir once the connection is ready, and again on every reconnect.

optional.name: reconnect_delay_ms
optional.description: Milliseconds between reconnect attempts

optional.name: defaultGroups
optional.description: Word groups active on every connect/reconnect. Same syntax as the expect action: 'CONFIRM:ja,schon,doch | DISCONFIRM:nein,nee,gar nicht'. Leave empty to disable.

optional.name: defaultGroupsTimeout
optional.description: Timeout in seconds for defaultGroups (default 3600 = 1 h). Re-applied on every reconnect.

optional.name: connectedVar
optional.description: true while WebSocket is live

optional.name: vadActiveVar
optional.description: VAD active (hysteresis-smoothed)

optional.name: vadSpeechRatioVar
optional.description: VAD speech ratio 0.0-1.0 (every 30 ms)

optional.name: sadActiveVar
optional.description: SAD active (sound detected)

optional.name: sadLevelDbVar
optional.description: RMS sound level in dB (every 30 ms)

optional.name: asrActiveVar
optional.description: true between utterance start and final/cancel

optional.name: asrPartialVar
optional.description: Accumulated partial text (clears on final)

optional.name: asrTextVar
optional.description: Last non-provisional final transcript

optional.name: asrLanguageVar
optional.description: Detected language of last final

optional.name: asrSpeakerVar
optional.description: Speaker profile ID if known, else empty

optional.name: asrExpectedVar
optional.description: true if last final matched an expected word

optional.name: asrMatchedLabelVar
optional.description: Event fired on each expected-word match; value is the group label (e.g. CONFIRM/DISCONFIRM) or empty string for unlabeled matches. Sceneflow edge: asr_matched_label == "CONFIRM"

optional.name: asrConfigLanguageVar
optional.description: Currently configured ASR language (e.g. "German"). Updated on connect (from ready message) and whenever set_language takes effect (from config message).

optional.name: turnEndProbVar
optional.description: SmartTurn turn-end probability 0.0-1.0

optional.name: diarizationVar
optional.description: Raw JSON of latest diarization result

optional.name: recordingActiveVar
optional.description: true while the fast-asr server is recording the microphone stream

optional.name: lastRecordingFileVar
optional.description: Full path of the most recently saved recording (updated on stop_recording and get_last_recorded_audio)

commands.name: expect
commands.summary: Register words the dialogue agent expects the user to say
commands.description:
Puts the ASR server into expectation mode. Matched words bypass the noise gate and hallucination filter. The first match fires the asr_matched_label event and clears the expectation. Three word-list formats are supported:

1. Flat list — words only, no labels:
   words='ja, nein, doch'
   → asr_matched_label fires with empty string value

2. Labeled groups — pipe-separated, each group prefixed LABEL:words:
   words='CONFIRM:ja,schon,doch,okay | DISCONFIRM:nein,nee,gar nicht'
   → asr_matched_label fires with the matching label (e.g. "CONFIRM")
   → sceneflow edge: asr_matched_label == "CONFIRM"

3. Catch-all group — bare label with no words, added after other groups:
   words='CONFIRM:ja,okay | DISCONFIRM:nein | OTHER'
   → OTHER fires when the user says something audible that matches none
     of the named groups; asr_text holds what was actually said
   → all three formats clear the expectation on first match

params.name: words
params.description: Word list in one of three formats: (1) flat: 'ja, nein, doch' — (2) labeled groups: 'CONFIRM:ja,okay | DISCONFIRM:nein,nee' — (3) with catch-all: 'CONFIRM:ja | DISCONFIRM:nein | OTHER'. Pipe | separates groups; colon : separates label from words; bare label with no colon is the catch-all.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Seconds before the expectation auto-expires on the server (default 30). Use a VSM timeout guard on the same node for the no-response branch.

commands.name: set_language
commands.summary: Change the ASR recognition language for the next utterance

commands.name: mute
commands.summary: Stop processing microphone audio — use before TTS starts speaking
commands.description: Instructs the fast-asr server to discard all incoming audio chunks silently. No VAD/SAD/ASR output is generated while muted. Use this immediately before a TTS utterance to prevent the microphone from picking up speaker output. Always paired with unmute.

commands.name: unmute
commands.summary: Resume microphone processing — use after TTS finishes speaking
commands.description: Instructs the fast-asr server to resume normal audio processing. The server first flushes any audio that accumulated in the capture queue during the muted period, ensuring that TTS bleed does not reach the ASR pipeline. Use this immediately after a TTS utterance completes.

commands.name: start_recording
commands.summary: Start recording the live microphone stream
commands.description: Calls POST /start_recording on the fast-asr server. The recording directory is configured once via the recording_dir plugin config (sent automatically on connect), so no directory needs to be given here. Fails silently (logged only) if a recording is already in progress; recordingActiveVar is set true on success.

commands.name: stop_recording
commands.summary: Stop the active recording and save it as an MP3
commands.description: Calls POST /stop_recording on the fast-asr server. On success, recordingActiveVar is set false and lastRecordingFileVar is updated with the full path of the saved file. Fails silently (logged only) if no recording was in progress or no audio was captured.

commands.name: get_last_recorded_audio
commands.summary: Look up the most recently saved recording
commands.description: Calls GET /get_last_recorded_audio on the fast-asr server and writes the full path into lastRecordingFileVar. Useful to re-read the last recording without waiting for a stop_recording response. Logged (not written) if no recording has been saved yet.

writes.description: Match event — enqueued on each expected-word match; consumed by sceneflow guard
Full path of the last saved recording
